_comment: Default bindings for player 1, as Chimera's Genesis Plus GX package binds them. The user's own bindings always win.

Genesis Controller.P1 Up: Up, J1 POV0U, X1 DpadUp, X1 LStickUp
Genesis Controller.P1 Down: Down, J1 POV0D, X1 DpadDown, X1 LStickDown
Genesis Controller.P1 Left: Left, J1 POV0L, X1 DpadLeft, X1 LStickLeft
Genesis Controller.P1 Right: Right, J1 POV0R, X1 DpadRight, X1 LStickRight
